cohort: Nulliparous births in California between 2000 and 2012
finding: While women with disabilities were less likely to undergo labor, those who did were more likely to have a medical indication for a cesarean delivery, and among those who did not labor, cesarean deliveries were less likely to have a documented medical indication.
mod_finding: This study found that women with disabilities were less likely to have a labored delivery and more likely to have a cesarean delivery, even after adjusting for medical indications.
